correctness.rationale: Finite exhaustive proof on the explicit 18-vertex incidence graph. Independent C++ and Python implementations enumerate every subset of sizes 1–7, reproduce 6912 minimum configurations with no smaller forcing sets, reconstruct each legal jump/slide and both connected graphs. C++ breadth-first search from all 6912 roots verifies radii, diameters and eccentricity distributions. Python independently verifies 216 base automorphisms, 35 orbits and BFS from all orbit representatives, reproducing every graph invariant. Four packaged source/output artifacts can be replayed; finite proof does not imply any result for larger graphs.

value.rationale: The 18-vertex Pappus graph is a canonical cubic symmetric incidence graph, and minimal zero forcing concerns matrix nullity and propagation/controllability. The exact 6912-state structural census answers a natural optimal-seed mobility question beyond the minimum seed number. In particular, unrestricted exchanges preserve distance-homogeneity of eccentricity seven, while local slides retain connectivity but create diameter eighteen and three eccentricity classes. Exact finite classification and a verified 216-automorphism reduction are substantial object-specific results, not arbitrary numerical slices or a textbook deduction.
